I tried all three.

Version 1 feels the most natural to me. I click "Mark done," and it flips to Done — and then the button turns into "Move to To read," which I really like because it tells me I can put it back if I marked it done by mistake. That two-way toggle in one obvious spot is exactly how I'd think about it.

Version 2, the checkbox, is fine and I get the "tick it off when you've read it" idea, but it felt a little one-directional — less obvious how I'd undo it. Version 3, the dropdown, was the most fiddly: open the menu, then pick — more steps than this simple two-state thing deserves.

So Version 1, please. The one thing I care about most there is that it goes both ways — done back to to-read, not just a one-time action — and that version does that.

And yes, I'm keen to talk about how the two piles actually separate next, since here you kept it in place just to show the change. In real use I'd want my "to read" list and my "done"/read stuff to feel like distinct places, so I'm glad that's the next thing.
